plans.idea: Faithful centred stack that keeps the original's reading order (logo, then a much larger bottle, then headline with the CTA directly beneath) and gives the bottle the extra height the tall format offers.

Headline-first poster: a big headline across the top, a large centred bottle as the visual anchor, the CTA under the product, and the logo signing off at the bottom, so the eye runs top to bottom from message to product to action to brand.

Left-aligned editorial layout: the logo and a large headline hang on the left edge at the top, the bottle sits large in the lower right, and the CTA anchors the lower left, so the elements read along a diagonal.
